Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Confirmed, data entry error. Note the corrections in P.Gen. IV 183.14 n.: lin11 Κλεπτος ποιουμένης => κλεπτοσπορουμένης; lin17 Κλεπτος .1[.?] => κλεπτοσπ̣[ορουμένης] [.?]

Submit - I added a χ in the fourth line (transforming πραθέντων into πραχθέντων), because the letter iis visible in the papyrus. The χ was included in the PSI edition (link:https://archive.org/details/papirigrecielati05sociuoft/page/17). This change also seems to improve the global meaning.

Commit - I added a χ to the word πραθέντ̣[ω]ν̣ in the fourth line, because it’s visible in the papyrus and the PSI edition (link: https://archive.org/details/papirigrecielati05sociuoft/page/17) includes it.
